title: QuickLaunch capacity tiles + graceful-fallback visual assets for Dedicated onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact set of UI assets for the Dedicated onboarding quickstart flow. Focus: compact capacity tiles (reserve/burst/auto-scale) for the first-run wizard, a small set of graceful-fallback illustrations + microcopy for capacity limits and SLA visibility, and annotated export-ready screenshots for engineering. Assets should be optimized for a 3-column onboarding card layout and mobile-responsive variants. Work includes exploration, final comps, annotated spec sheet, and developer handoff package (SVG/PNG + tokenized microcopy).
deliverables: 3 capacity tile variants (Low / Balanced / High) - SVG + PNG
Autoscaling explainer micro-animation frames (3) exported as Lottie JSON and PNG sequence
SLA snapshot bar component visuals (ok/warning/at-risk) with copy variants
3 fallback/empty-state illustrations for capacity limit, policy fallback, and capacity-suggestor prompt
Annotated screenshots for onboarding flow (desktop + mobile) with launch knobs highlighted
Tokenized microcopy file (CSV) for localization and QA
Design spec doc with spacing, color tokens, and accessibility notes
acceptance_criteria: All assets exported and uploaded to Drive in ./DedicatedOnboard/QuickLaunch/ by due date
Engineering sign-off on spec doc: spacing, responsive breakpoints, and token names
PM approves microcopy variants and selects primary copy for each tile
Contrast checks pass WCAG AA for primary CTA and SLA bars
Fallback illustrations approve by UX writing and product for tone-of-voice
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha: Kickoff note. Aligned with PM on a compact 3-tile primary layout to reduce cognitive load for new Dedicated customers. PM requested explicit burst-capacity tooltip and SLA microcopy variants (technical + plain-language).

2026-03-11 - Marco: Exploration thumbnails uploaded. Two visual directions: 'minimal telemetry' (icon-first) and 'econ-first' (cost-first emphasis). Engineering highlighted constraint: tile heights must be constant to avoid layout shift during autoscaling previews.

2026-03-12 - PM (Lina Chen): Prefer 'econ-first' as primary. Need to surface predicted cost-per-hour and expected latency ranges for each tile. Flagged data source: runtime-metrics/throughput-estimates API. Added ENG-38402 dependency.

2026-03-13 - Accessibility review (Jamal): Color adjustments suggested for SLA amber state; raised contrast issue on orange-on-white labels. Updated tokens in Figma and added accessible alt text for fallback illustrations.

2026-03-14 - Marco: Final comps ready in Figma. Export checklist: SVG icons as single-path, 1x/2x PNGs for screenshots, Lottie frames exported. Open question for PM: Should the 'Suggest Capacity' CTA trigger an inline estimator modal or a full-screen calculator?
2026-03-14 - Lina Chen: Decide inline estimator modal to keep users in quickstart flow. Added follow-up task to ENG for telemetry hook (ENG-38901).
